_readme: Articles on perspectives.html. 'url' = published elsewhere (opens in a new tab) or an existing page on this site. For an article hosted here, leave out 'url' and put its body (HTML) in tools/perspectives/posts/<slug>.html; build.py then writes perspective-<slug>.html. 'mark' is the big character on the cover; 'short' is a shorter title for the cover only. 'hidden': true keeps a series or post out of the page (the Substack newsletter is hidden for now). "hero": false keeps "photo" for the cover only (no large photo at the top of the article). "original": the page first appeared elsewhere (the Prologue blog); search engines are pointed to it. "art": the drawing (tools/perspectives/art.py) for the book cover and the top of the article.
